To add a YouTube video to OptiSigns, follow these steps:

* Go to the OptiSigns portal, navigate to **Files/Assets**, and select **Apps**.
* Search for **YouTube** and select the standard **YouTube** app.
* Give your asset a **Name** and paste your public or unlisted YouTube video, share, or Shorts link into the **URL** field.
* Configure optional display settings (such as Captions or Mute) or playback options (like Start At/End At times), then click **Save**.
* Deploy the saved app to your screen by going to **Screens**, clicking **Edit**, setting the Content Type to **Asset**, choosing your YouTube app, and clicking **Save**.

For more details, check out the full guide: [Article URL: How to Use YouTube with OptiSigns](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051014713-How-to-Use-YouTube-with-OptiSigns)
